test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the given number, symbol series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) 7 $ 5 @ 3 ! 3 5 6 7 & % $ 3 # 2 7 + ? > < (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the right?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 7 $ 5 @ 3 ! 3 5 6 7 & % $ 3 # 2 7 + ? > (Left) $ @ ! & % $ # + ? > 

The 7th element from the right → (Left) $ @ ! & __**%**__ $ # + ? > → %

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
